title: D1-1b: Candidate Membrane Screening + Stress Testing + Final Selection
question_prompt:
D1-1b: Candidate Membrane Screening + Stress Testing + Final Selection

An SWRO project has a fixed membrane area and design pressure. Procurement has provided four candidate membranes. The agent must first screen all candidates under the nominal condition, then send only the passing shortlist to a high-salinity stress test. Eliminated membranes should not receive further tool calls. If any candidates remain after the salinity stress test, verify them under the low- and high-temperature design conditions before making the final selection.

Fixed parameters | Value | Unit | Notes | Design / stress case | NaCl mass fraction | Temperature °C
Feed mass flow | 4.073 | kg/s | Fixed | Nominal | 0.03 | 32
Membrane area | 400 | m² | Fixed | High salinity stress | 0.032 | 32
Feed pressure | 52 | bar | Fixed | Low temperature verify | 0.03 | 25
Permeate pressure | 1.013 | bar | Fixed | High temperature verify | 0.03 | 35
Pressure drop | 0.653 | bar | Fixed
Channel height | 0.002 | m | Fixed | Common hard constraints
Spacer porosity | 0.75 | - | Fixed | Qp | ≥ 6.10 m³/h | All mandatory cases
Module length | 20 | m | Fixed | Recovery | ≤ 48% | All mandatory cases
Flux | ≤ 18 LMH | All mandatory cases
Four candidate membranes | Rejection | ≥ 98.7% | All mandatory cases
Membrane | A_comp | B_comp | Design intent | Permeate NaCl | ≤ 400 mg/L | All mandatory cases
M1 High-flux | 5e-12 | 5e-08 | High A / high B
M2 High-productivity | 4.5e-12 | 3.6e-08 | Higher A / medium-high B
M3 Balanced-high rejection | 4.35e-12 | 2.8e-08 | Medium-high A / low B
M4 High-rejection | 3.3e-12 | 2.4e-08 | Low A / very low B

Required tasks
1. E1 — Identify this as a membrane-performance parameter selection problem. Explain the A/B trade-off and anticipate typical risks for high-A/high-B and low-A/low-B candidates.
2. E2 — Screen all four membranes under the nominal condition. Only membranes that satisfy every hard constraint may enter the shortlist.
3. E3 — Run the high-salinity stress test on the shortlist. Eliminate any membrane that fails and stop that branch.
4. E4 — For the final surviving candidate(s), run both the 25°C low-temperature and 35°C high-temperature verification cases. Do not make a procurement decision from a single temperature.
5. Final recommendation — Base the decision on all mandatory cases and explain why the best choice is not simply the membrane with the highest A or the lowest B.

Multi-call principle: nominal screening → shortlist → high-salinity stress → low/high-temperature verification of the final candidate(s). Other reasonable orders are acceptable, but eliminated membranes should not receive low-information stress tests.
reference_answer:
D1-1b: Gold Answer — Screening → Shortlist → Stress Test

Reference efficient trajectory: about 8 simulate_ro calls. Nominal screening uses 4 calls and retains M2/M3. High-salinity stress uses 2 calls; M2 is eliminated because permeate NaCl > 400 mg/L. Only M3 then receives the 25°C low-temperature and 35°C high-temperature verification calls.

steps.step_label: TQ1 Problem representation and state understanding
steps.reasoning_or_calculation: Correctly identify the decision variables, the A/B trade-off, and the multi-condition requirement
steps.inputs: Understands the roles of A/B but incompletely handles the multi-condition requirement or one hard constraint
steps.key_outputs: Recognizes that A mainly controls water permeability/production and B mainly controls salt passage/water quality; candidates must pass both nominal and stress conditions
steps.full_credit: Recognizes that A mainly controls water permeability/production and B mainly controls salt passage/water quality; candidates must pass both nominal and stress conditions
steps.common_failures: Ranks only by highest A or lowest B; treats pressure/area as candidate-specific comparison variables

steps.reasoning_or_calculation: Build a causal screening → shortlist → stress → final-verification plan
steps.inputs: Overall plan is reasonable but lacks shortlist pruning or one final verification
steps.key_outputs: Screen 4 membranes at nominal → retain M2/M3 only → high-salinity stress → eliminate M2 → verify M3 at both low and high temperature
steps.full_credit: Screen 4 membranes at nominal → retain M2/M3 only → high-salinity stress → eliminate M2 → verify M3 at both low and high temperature
steps.common_failures: Brute-force all 4 membranes × all cases, or select a membrane from nominal results alone

steps.reasoning_or_calculation: Use fair and consistent simulate_ro settings across candidates and stress cases
steps.inputs: Minor parameter/unit errors that do not change elimination outcomes
steps.key_outputs: All inputs remain fixed except candidate A/B and the case-specific salinity/temperature; Qp, Recovery, Flux, Rejection, and NaCl are read correctly
steps.full_credit: All inputs remain fixed except candidate A/B and the case-specific salinity/temperature; Qp, Recovery, Flux, Rejection, and NaCl are read correctly
steps.common_failures: Changes pressure/area across candidates, or uses incorrect units/thresholds and creates an unfair comparison

steps.step_label: TQ4 Observation interpretation and state update
steps.reasoning_or_calculation: Correctly maintain shortlist state from the observations
steps.inputs: Final shortlist is correct, but one elimination reason or metric interpretation is incomplete
steps.key_outputs: M1 is eliminated by recovery/water quality; M4 by production; M2/M3 enter the shortlist; M2 fails high salinity at NaCl≈409.84 mg/L; M3 continues
steps.full_credit: M1 is eliminated by recovery/water quality; M4 by production; M2/M3 enter the shortlist; M2 fails high salinity at NaCl≈409.84 mg/L; M3 continues
steps.common_failures: Incorrect keep/eliminate state; ignores the salinity failure and keeps M2

steps.reasoning_or_calculation: Let screening results drive later stress tests and prune branches promptly
steps.inputs: Some pruning is applied, but unnecessary verification remains or stress ordering is unclear
steps.key_outputs: Run high-salinity stress only on M2/M3; stop M2 after failure; test only M3 at 25/35°C; then compare engineering margins
steps.full_credit: Run high-salinity stress only on M2/M3; stop M2 after failure; test only M3 at 25/35°C; then compare engineering margins
steps.common_failures: Continues extensive testing of eliminated membranes; call order is unrelated to previous states

steps.step_label: TQ6 Stopping and final engineering decision
steps.reasoning_or_calculation: Stop after all mandatory evidence is complete and make the correct membrane decision
steps.inputs: Recommends M3 but omits one verification or part of the engineering explanation
steps.key_outputs: M3 is the only candidate that passes nominal, high-salinity, 25°C, and 35°C cases; recommend M3 and explain the balanced A/B trade-off
steps.full_credit: M3 is the only candidate that passes nominal, high-salinity, 25°C, and 35°C cases; recommend M3 and explain the balanced A/B trade-off
steps.common_failures: Recommends M1/M2/M4, or stops before stress testing is complete

dimensions.evaluation_focus: Choose the correct tool and avoid irrelevant tools
dimensions.full_credit: Use simulate_ro for the scientific calculations, with each call directly serving the current decision
dimensions.medium_credit: A few unnecessary metadata or exploratory calls
dimensions.low_credit: Wrong tools or many irrelevant calls
dimensions.case_observation: simulate_ro is sufficient for fair membrane comparison; no plant-cost or chemistry tools are needed

dimensions.dimension_label: E2 Information gain and call ordering
dimensions.full_credit: Establish the baseline/screening structure first, then refine only where uncertainty remains
dimensions.medium_credit: Mostly reasonable ordering but with some low-information calls
dimensions.low_credit: Starts with dense grid testing without first structuring the problem
dimensions.case_observation: Nominal screening provides the highest initial discrimination

dimensions.evaluation_focus: Make each next call depend on prior observations
dimensions.full_credit: Dynamically choose inputs from fail/pass status, shortlist state, and risk type
dimensions.medium_credit: Partly adaptive, mixed with preset enumeration
dimensions.low_credit: Call sequence is largely independent of previous results
dimensions.case_observation: The shortlist determines salinity stress; salinity elimination determines the final verification target

dimensions.evaluation_focus: Prune failed branches and avoid redundant calls
dimensions.full_credit: Stop branches once failure evidence is sufficient; do not repeat equivalent inputs
dimensions.medium_credit: A small amount of repetition or 1–2 extra tests on known branches
dimensions.low_credit: Continues extensive testing of eliminated options or brute-forces all combinations
dimensions.case_observation: Stop M1/M4 after nominal elimination and M2 after salinity failure; do not run unnecessary temperature stress tests

dimensions.evaluation_focus: Converge with a reasonable call budget and stop when evidence is sufficient
dimensions.full_credit: About 7–9 calls with complete evidence and no obvious redundancy
dimensions.medium_credit: About 10–12 calls with minor redundancy but still adaptive
dimensions.low_credit: >12 calls with heavy enumeration/repetition, or too few calls to support the decision
dimensions.case_observation: Reference trajectory ≈8 calls; different efficient adaptive paths can receive full credit
